offering_description.value: Develops and sells oral targeted medicines for blood cancers and blood disorders. Sold to specialty pharmacies, distributors and hematology and oncology clinics, which dispense them to patients. Earns from drug sales and partner royalties on licensed products.

primary_products.value: oral leukemia medicine; oral immune thrombocytopenia medicine

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies, wholesale drug distributors, hospitals and oncology clinics

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription medicines sold to pharmacies and distributors; healthcare reimbursement: insurer and government payments for prescribed medicines; licensing or royalties: payments and royalties from partners selling licensed medicines outside the US
revenue_model.category: product sales; healthcare reimbursement; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets medicines made by contract manufacturers, sold to distributors

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide US sales, partners sell in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: two blood cancer and blood disorder medicines sharing the same prescriber base

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: hematology and oncology specialist sales force; distributors / dealers: specialty pharmacies and wholesale drug distributors; partners / resellers: licensed partner companies selling outside the US
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval needed to market and sell prescription medicines

notes: Marketed products and partner deals may have changed; confirm current product list.
